headline: Revenue inches up while operating margins deteriorate
summary_short: Bruker's Q1 FY2026 revenue of $823.4M rose 2.7% y/y but fell 15.7% q/q, with diluted EPS of $0.02 down 81.8% y/y as operating income dropped 67.9% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $823.4M rose 2.7% y/y but fell 15.7% q/q. Gross profit of $379.8M fell 2.9% y/y and 15.4% q/q. Operating income of $10.2M dropped 67.9% y/y and 90.9% q/q; EBITDA of $92.4M grew 4.3% y/y despite falling 32.8% q/q. Net income of $14.4M fell 17.2% y/y; diluted EPS of $0.02 fell 81.8% y/y. Total cash fell 27.6% y/y to $133.4M as long-term debt fell 20.9% y/y to $1,671.3M.
